QuestInfo.name: A Perk for Knights
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has prepared something very special for you, a Lv. 50-70 Knight of Virtue.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra has prepared something very special for you, a Lv. 50-70 Knight of Virtue.
QuestInfo.2: A gift just for you! Not bad at all. All you need to do now is focus on hunting monsters!

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. Thank you for agreeing to join the Knights of Virtue. We have a special gift for Knights between Levels 50 and 70. Would you like one?

no.0: I hope you don't miss out on this great opportunity. Come back soon, okay?

1.0: It's nothing big. The thing is, hunting grounds for Level 50 - 70 Knights of Virtue are really far away. This gift for them allows them to travel more easily. If you're interested, click on the light bulb.

yes.0: It's nothing big. The thing is, hunting grounds for Level 50 - 70 Knights of Virtue are really far away. This gift for them allows them to travel more easily.
yes.1: If you use the #bTeleport Rock of Virtue#k that I gave you, it will show you the list of hunting grounds for Levels 50 - 70. Check the level of the monsters first, and then move to the area by clicking it. Using #bVirtue's Blessing#k wisely can allow you to take on higher-level monsters than you normally can. Give it a try.

default.0: I'm afraid you're not a qualifying Knight of Virtue. Sorry.
